## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r comparative graphs}

library(Seurat) 
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(viridis)
library(BiocManager)
library(textshaping)
#library(RCurl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggpubr)
library(sctransform)
#library(ExperimentHub) #Bioconductor Install
library(scuttle) #Bioconductor Install
library(SingleR) #Bioconductor Install
library(writexl)

annotated_data <- readRDS("/Volumes/My Passport/Final Data/HarmonyIntegrated_annotated_data_final.rds")

# Subset for NS and COPD
subset_obj <- subset(annotated_data, subset = orig.ident %in% c("nonsmoker", "COPD"))

# Subset for Sm and COPD
subset_obj_1 <- subset(annotated_data, subset = orig.ident %in% c("smoker", "COPD"))

```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r plots, echo=TRUE}
#COPS vs NS

DimPlot(subset_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident")
subset1 <- DimPlot(subset_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", cols = c("#F8766D", "#89CFF0"), pt.size = 0.001)

print(subset1)

ggsave(subset1, filename = '/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/COPD paper/copd_vs_ns.tiff', width = 6, height =6)

#COPD vs Sm
subset2 <- DimPlot(subset_obj_1, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", cols = c("#F8766D", "#b0b0b04D"), pt.size = 0.001)

ggsave(subset2, filename = '/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/COPD paper/copd_vs_sm.tiff', width = 6, height =6)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
